def block_tops(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    tops={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']!='W' or n['pixels']<10: continue
        rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        tops[(min(cols),max(cols))]=min(rows)
    return tops

def strip_rows(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    s={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','p','Y') and n['pixels']>=3:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            s[n['color']]=(min(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return s

    delta={k:(now.get(k),prev.get(k)) for k in set(now)|set(prev) if now.get(k)!=prev.get(k)}
    print(f"click col{c}: delta {delta}")
    prev=now

def summarize(fr, label):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        px=n['pixels']
        if px<3: continue
        rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        out.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols),px))
    print(f"--- {label} (level {fr.level} step {fr.step}) ---")
    for c in sorted(out):
        print(c, out[c])

summarize(current_frame,"NOW")
# find level 3 start
start=None
for i,h in enumerate(history):
    if h.frame.level==3:
        start=i; break
print("level3 first history idx", start)
if start is not None:
    summarize(history[start].frame,"L3-start")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def block_tops(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    tops={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']!='W' or n['pixels']<10: continue
        rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        tops[(min(cols),max(cols))]=min(rows)
    return tops

def strip_rows(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    s={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','p','Y') and n['pixels']>=3:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            s[n['color']]=(min(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return s

print("NOW tops", block_tops(current_frame))
print("NOW strips", strip_rows(current_frame))
# probe each blue square once
blue_cols=[12,16,24,28,34,38,46,50]
prev=block_tops(current_frame)
for c in blue_cols:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':56,'col':c}])
    now=block_tops(current_frame)
    delta={k:(now.get(k),prev.get(k)) for k in set(now)|set(prev) if now.get(k)!=prev.get(k)}
    print(f"click col{c}: delta {delta}")
    prev=now
print("FINAL tops", block_tops(current_frame))
print("FINAL strips", strip_rows(current_frame))
print("last result", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('done'))
